E_INVALID_DOCUMENT: The import root is not a JSON object.
E_JSON_PARSE_ERROR: JSON source could not be parsed.
E_MARKDOWN_PARSE_ERROR: Markdown source does not match TabVault grammar.
E_UNKNOWN_SCHEMA_VERSION: The server does not support this schema version.
E_MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD: A required field is absent or empty.
E_INVALID_OBJECT: An entity is not represented as an object.
E_INVALID_URL: A tab URL is not an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL.
E_DUPLICATE_ID: An identifier is duplicated inside the document.
E_DUPLICATE_URL: Two tabs resolve to the same normalized URL.
E_UNKNOWN_GROUP_REFERENCE: A group or tab references a group that does not exist.
E_INVALID_TAGS: A tab tag list is not an array of strings.
W_ORPHAN_TAG: A tag is missing from the directory and will be created.
W_DUPLICATE_URL: An upload was merged into an existing tab because the URL already exists.
